extras: Detailed development commands and deployment instructions are provided in the README.
intentEvidence: Heading Mindmap is an Obsidian plugin that opens Markdown heading structures as editable mind maps.
problem: Users often struggle to visualize the hierarchical structure of a long Markdown document or quickly navigate and edit specific sections without losing context.
summary: Heading Mindmap opens Markdown heading structures as editable mind maps, allowing users to visualize and interact with document hierarchy while keeping Markdown as the source of truth.
